Original Eurostat geographic code, retained without substitution.
Previous residence partner → reporting country geo; people of any occupation. Does not identify skilled/ICT workers.

REACH: age reached during reference year; COMPLET: age in completed years. Keep separate, never sum or silently pool.
TOTAL all ages versus Y15-64 age 15–64; TOTAL includes the age subset, so do not add them.

Verbatim Eurostat source status. Blank flag does not imply that a blank value is zero.

matched_country_year, country_outside_base_panel, year_outside_base_panel, missing_country_year_in_base, or unmapped_country_code. A matched key can still have a missing covariate.
